steps.en: Download the release binaries and run the login tool; scan the QR code with the Xiaohongshu app
steps.zh: 下载发布版二进制，跑登录工具，用小红书 App 扫码

steps.en: Fetches its bundled fingerprint browser once (SHA256-checked) and saves the session to cookies.json
steps.zh: 首次下载内置指纹浏览器并校验，把登录态存进 cookies.json

steps.en: Start the server binary (headless by default)
steps.zh: 启动服务二进制（默认无头模式）

steps.en: Serves MCP tools and a REST API on port 18060, reusing the saved login
steps.zh: 在 18060 端口提供 MCP 工具和 REST 接口，复用已存登录态

steps.en: Register its URL in your MCP client
steps.zh: 把服务地址登记到你的 MCP 客户端
steps.code: claude mcp add --transport http xiaohongshu-mcp http://localhost:18060/mcp

steps.en: Ask in plain words: write a post about spring with these local images and publish it
steps.zh: 用大白话下指令：配这几张本地图写一篇春天的帖子并发布

steps.en: Fills the creator page in a headless browser with human-like clicks and typing, then publishes
steps.zh: 在无头浏览器里拟人化点击、输入，填好创作页并发布

value.en: No more pasting agent-written copy and images into the creator page by hand; search, note details and comments also come back as data your agent can read
value.zh: 不用再把 Agent 写好的文案和图片手动搬进创作页；搜索、笔记详情和评论也直接以数据形式回到 Agent 手里

sources: https://github.com/xpzouying/xiaohongshu-mcp README 1.1 快速开始 (release binaries xiaohongshu-login-darwin-arm64 / xiaohongshu-mcp-darwin-arm64; first run downloads a ~150MB browser) and 1.2 登录 / 1.3 启动 MCP 服务
README 2.1 Claude Code CLI 接入 (claude mcp add --transport http xiaohongshu-mcp http://localhost:18060/mcp) and 2.4 使用示例 (natural-language publish prompt with local images)
browser/browser_download.go (download from the self-hosted CDN, SHA256SUMS verification) and cookies/cookies.go (cookies.json session file)
routes.go (/mcp and /api/v1/* on the same server), main.go (-port default :18060), humanize/ (log-normal timing for clicks, typing, scrolling)
